metric_correction.interpretation: The legacy global event-DD calculation interleaved independently week-local accounting states and could temporarily mark a same-timestamp due-to-close position beyond its defined exit while another due position was processed first. Using the final post-close state at each timestamp within each evaluated week removes that measurement artifact without changing decisions, sizing, P&L, weekly returns or ending balance.
